column1: # Alaya Pulse -- Question Import Template
# HOW TO USE
# 1. Prepare your questions in a Word document with correct answers and explanations if needed
# 2. Upload this template and your Word document to Gemini (or ChatGPT / Claude)
# 3. Paste the prompt from the Alaya Pulse import window (it has a Copy button)
# 4. Download the CSV file the AI gives you
# 5. In Alaya Pulse open a deck and click Import > Import questions in CSV and upload the file
# RULES FOR FILLING IN THIS TEMPLATE (for you or the AI)
# - Keep the header row (the row starting with type) exactly as it is
# - Replace the example rows at the bottom with your own questions -- one question per row
# - Lines starting with # are instructions and are ignored on import
# type -- one of: mcq | wordcloud | openended | rating | ranking
# mcq -- multiple choice
#   Put the answer options in option_a onwards (2 to 100 options)
#   correct = the column letter of the right answer e.g. B -- or several e.g. A|C|D
#   explanation = why the answer is correct (optional -- shown after the answer is revealed)
#   timer = seconds to answer -- leave blank for 30
# rating -- people score each item on a scale
#   Put the things to rate in option_a onwards (1 to 5 items) e.g. Workload then Communication
#   Leave correct / explanation / timer blank
# ranking -- people put items in order of importance
#   Put the items to rank in option_a onwards (2 to 10 items)
#   Leave correct / explanation / timer blank
# wordcloud and openended -- no options needed
#   Leave option columns / correct / explanation / timer blank
# MORE THAN 6 OPTIONS
#   Add more columns to the header: option_g then option_h and so on up to option_z
#   For very long lists use numbered columns instead: option_1 to option_100
#   With numbered columns write correct as the number e.g. 34 -- or several e.g. 3|17|22
